settings.title: Channel Settings

controller.otherDevice: Creating share links and handing out new access when participants change happen on another of your devices.
controller.notConnected: The device doing this now is not connected, so it could not be switched. Open the app on that device and try again.
controller.waiting: Waiting for the device doing this now to respond. Opening the app on that device switches it to this device.
controller.moving: Switching the device that does this. Until it finishes, creating share links and handing out new access are on hold.
controller.movingStuck: If the device it is switching to can no longer be used, recreate the channel.

title: Private Channels
intro: A private channel is a space inside this topic where only participants can read and write posts. Create one yourself, or join with an invite or share link from a participant. Invite and share links are created from the channel settings after you join.

controllerPending.title: On hold
controllerPending.description: This action needs new access to be handed out, which happens on another of your devices. It stays on hold until you open the app on that device, so try again after opening it. You can also switch this to this device in the channel settings.
